summary: National Healthcare Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 8, 2026, reporting it entered a definitive purchase and sale agreement on May 4, 2026, to sell a portfolio of 86 outpatient medical facilities for approximately $528 million, including about $278 million of secured debt defeased or assumed by the buyer. The buyer is an affiliated third party. The transaction is expected to close in Q3 or Q4 2026, subject to buyer due diligence, lender approval of loan assumption, and other customary conditions. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium stated. Watch for buyer diligence outcome and lender approvals; risk-arb focuses on closing timeline and any purchase price adjustments.
